products.title: Oak Side Table
products.description: A solid white oak side table with a 40cm round top and tapered legs, finished in hardwax oil. Arrives assembled.

products.title: Ash Bar Stool, 65cm
products.description: A steam-bent ash stool with a shaped seat and footrail, 65cm to seat height. Stackable in pairs.

products.title: Wall-Mounted Shelf Unit
products.description: Three fixed oak shelves in a powder-coated steel frame, 90cm wide. Wall fixings included for masonry and stud.

products.title: Nesting Coffee Tables, Pair
products.description: A pair of nesting tables in oak veneer over birch ply, 50cm and 40cm diameter. Sit flush when stacked.

products.title: Slim Hallway Console
products.description: A 22cm deep console in solid ash with a single open shelf, sized for narrow hallways.

products.title: Upholstered Bench Seat
products.description: A 110cm bench with a wool-blend seat pad over a beech frame. Removable cover, dry clean only.

products.title: Bedside Cabinet, Single Drawer
products.description: An oak bedside cabinet with one soft-close drawer and an open lower shelf. 45cm wide.

products.title: Linen Cushion Cover, 45cm
products.description: A washed linen cushion cover with a concealed zip, 45cm square. Insert not included.

products.title: Lambswool Throw
products.description: A lambswool throw woven in a herringbone weave, 130 by 180cm, with a hand-knotted fringe.

products.title: Round Wall Mirror, 50cm
products.description: A 50cm round mirror in a slim brass-finished frame, with a fixed hanging bracket on the reverse.

products.title: Stoneware Vase, Tall
products.description: A hand-thrown stoneware vase in a matt oatmeal glaze, 28cm tall, watertight.

products.title: Dinner Candle Set, Six
products.description: Six unscented dinner candles in undyed beeswax, 25cm, with an eight-hour burn time each.

pages.about: Ledbury & Frame make and source furniture and homewares for small flats and narrow houses. We began building slim-depth consoles for a friend's hallway in 2023 and now work with two workshops in the Midlands. Everything is sized deliberately: nothing in the range is deeper than 45cm.
pages.refund_policy: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery in original condition. Furniture over 20kg is collected by our carrier at a flat 25 dollar fee deducted from the refund. Homewares under 5kg can be returned by post at your own cost. Refunds are issued within 5 working days of the item arriving back with us.
pages.shipping_policy: All items are held in stock. Orders placed before 2pm are dispatched the same working day; everything else goes out the next working day. Homewares arrive in 3 to 5 working days by tracked courier. Furniture is delivered in 3 to 5 working days on a two-person service to a room of your choice. We do not accept back-orders or made-to-order commissions.
